run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run under the same persistent hard egress block as every prior run: the session network policy denies all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts (a fresh WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm again returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND this run), so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened and every captured tender is headline-level only. Tier 1 was swept via WebSearch snapshots across AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/VendorPanel (Qld), Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders. As in recent runs, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders were by far the richest live sources; this run Buying for Victoria also yielded usable current listings (the first Victorian captures in recent runs). All 21 prior opportunities were carried forward (none had closed as at the run date); 12 of them were explicitly re-observed as still open in this run's buyer-originated snapshots (the NT QTOL December/January tenders plus ACT 39215-RFT-400, 52652-RFT-002 and 30995-RFT-420), the remainder carried forward without live re-verification. Eleven genuinely new opportunities were captured: four NT QTOL (T26-1280 Darwin Defence laundry decking, NTG25-0223 dental consumables panel, OSM013-26 Owen Springs cooling system, T26-1376 Darwin air-conditioning R&M), four ACT (38576-DOC-001, 39363-DOC-002 [prequal CE/CEC], 39273-RFT-001 [prequal CLA/CEC], 39215-RFT-200 City and Environment), and three Victorian (T421508 Ports Victoria heavy construction, T2026-0812 DEECA building cleaning/maintenance, RFT00000031 Mallee CMA environmental services). The four NT QTOL additions include two closing 13 Jan 2027 after the published QTOL Christmas/New-Year break (last release/close 18 Dec 2026, first 13 Jan 2027). Tier 2 (Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water, South East Water, WaterNSW, universities/TAFE/CSIRO) was sampled — no publicly-visible open opportunity with a current closing date (these route via SAP Ariba, Zycus or their own registration-gated portals); a live University of Notre Dame Managed SOC Services RFT was seen but had no legible closing date so was not captured. Tier 3 (mandatory): SAP Ariba Discovery and major buyers BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside were queried; all open RFx remain login-gated or visible only via aggregators/ICN Gateway, so no corporate tender was captured and the portals are recorded in discovered_sources. Three new sources found (South East Water, WaterNSW, University of Notre Dame procurement); QTenders' current host (qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au) and EstimateOne were also added to the known-source list.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged, re-tested this run): the session network policy denies all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts. A fresh WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, matching every prior run, so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened. Every tender this run is headline-level only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts and most commercial fields are null. Restoring full discovery and deliverables extraction requires allowing the Tier 1/2/3 tender hosts in the session's network settings.

Tier 1: AusTender, buy.nsw, QTenders/VendorPanel (Qld), Tenders WA, Tenders SA and Tenders Tasmania could only be read through cached WebSearch snapshots, many stale. buy.nsw again returned only demo/template pages (demo.buy.nsw.gov.au) with no real dates — no current NSW Government opportunity could be captured. Tenders WA returned only regional opportunity-bulletin PDFs (newest ~Aug 2026) and a stale Christmas notice. Newly-published (last 24-48h) listings on these portals are very likely under-captured. NT QTOL, ACT Tenders and Buying for Victoria were the usable exceptions this run.

Tenders SA: WebSearch for the South Australian portal was again partly hijacked by South African results and returned only September/October 2026 closing dates (contracts.sa.gov.au / procurement.sa.gov.au / DIT Future Tender Program). No current SA Government opportunity could be captured this run. Deferred / needs direct portal access.

QTenders (Qld): only platform/landing snapshots were legible (one VendorPanel display id VP476307 / tender id 55095 surfaced without readable dates). Queensland is mid-migration to VendorPanel (documents via https://www.supply.qld.gov.au), and the live QTenders host is now qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au. No Queensland state-government opportunity with a confirmable December closing date could be captured; Brisbane City Council (local gov) remains the Qld exception (carried forward).

ACT 38576-DOC-001, 39363-DOC-002, 39273-RFT-001 and 39215-RFT-200 were captured from the buyer-originated ACT Tenders open listing at reference-number + release/closing-date level only; their full titles, buying directorates (except 39215 = City and Environment) and scope could not be resolved because the detail pages are behind the egress block. A separate ACT reference 'PICH0008972' (closing 10 Dec 2026) also appeared this run; because a prior run concluded 'PICH0008972' was a mis-read of the Canberra Health Services RFT 30995-RFT-420 (closing 8 Dec 2026) and the two could not be disambiguated without the detail pages, PICH0008972 was NOT captured as a separate tender to avoid a possible duplicate. Needs direct portal access to resolve.

New Victorian captures (T421508 Ports Victoria, T2026-0812 DEECA, RFT00000031 Mallee CMA) are headline-level from the Buying for Victoria current-tenders snapshot; full titles/scope, publish dates and closing times could not be opened. An NT Katherine diesel-generator R&M tender (36 months, closing 13 Jan 2027) and Gordon TAFE RFT 202608/202609 (waste removal / HVAC, market approach ~Dec 2026, not yet open) were seen but NOT captured — no legible tender reference number (NT) / not yet open to market (TAFE).

Tier 2 (Sydney Water, SA Water, Melbourne Water, South East Water, WaterNSW, universities/TAFE/CSIRO): sampled, but no publicly-visible open opportunity with a current (Nov 2026 - Jan 2027) closing date and a legible closing date was found — these route tendering through SAP Ariba, Zycus or their own registration-gated portals. A live University of Notre Dame 'Managed SOC Services' RFT was visible but had no legible closing date, so it was recorded as a discovered source rather than captured as a tender.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery and major buyers BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside): queried as mandatory; all open RFx are login-gated or only visible via aggregators/ICN Gateway (NeoSmelt JV EOI already closed 18 Dec 2025; BHP Port Debottlenecking / Ministers North appear only as AIP plan summaries, not open tenders). No authenticated session is available, so no corporate opportunity was publicly visible and none was fabricated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources.

Tier 3 construction (EstimateOne): open subcontractor packages exist (e.g. via Kane Constructions and other Tier-1/mid-tier builders) but head-contractor attribution and documents are behind a free supplier login; recorded as a discovered source, not captured as tenders.
Tier 3 invitation-only RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs sent directly to shortlisted/panel suppliers) remain out of scope and undiscoverable by design.

Carried-forward opportunities NOT individually re-verified against the live portals this run (egress block): DFAT PNG ENABLE (closing 2026-12-01), Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI (2026-12-23), NT fire-detection T26-1304 (2026-12-03), NT vehicle-rental (2026-12-08), Territory Generation CIDC020-26 (2026-12-17), Defence DSARC alternate-energy (no closing date), WA FPC plantation RFP (no closing date), CSIRO RFT2026031 (no closing date), and both Brisbane City Council RFx (2026-12-18 / 2026-12-11). All are believed still open (closing dates still in the future) but were carried from prior runs, not reconfirmed this run.

CSIRO RFT CSIRORFT2026031, the WA FPC plantation RFP and the Defence DSARC managing-contractor ATM still have no publicly-visible closing date in the announcement (set in tender documents); left null.
recommended_seed_additions: South East Water procurement portal (southeastwater.com.au/.../procurement) — Victorian metropolitan water GBE running its own buyer-originated RFx; register a supplier account for authenticated reads. High confidence.
WaterNSW procurement (waternsw.com.au/about/procurement) — NSW state-owned bulk water supplier; buyer-originated and a pivot to sibling NSW utilities. High confidence.

University of Notre Dame Australia procurement/suppliers pages — a university that advertises some RFx (e.g. Managed SOC Services) openly on its own site rather than only via AusTender. Medium-high confidence; sibling discovery pattern for other private/NFP universities.

QTenders current host is qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au (not hpw.qld.gov.au) and Queensland is migrating response/documents to VendorPanel via supply.qld.gov.au — update the canonical Qld seed URL and check both QTenders and VendorPanel each run.
EstimateOne (estimateone.com) — canonical construction subcontractor-package platform used by Tier-1/mid-tier builders; register a free subcontractor account to read head-contractor work packages.

australiantenders.com.au as a DISCOVERY SIGNAL only (aggregator, not source of truth) — keep using it to spot new buyer tender IDs, then pivot to the buyer source. Do not record its listings as confirmed opportunities.
